props.name: title
props.description: Heading at the top; also the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the title, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: children
props.description: Body content. Laid out as a grid with field-gap spacing; scrolls when taller than the viewport allows.

props.name: footer
props.description: Actions aligned to the inline end. Stacked full-width on narrow screens.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Whether clicking the backdrop closes the dialog.

props.name: isOpen / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled open state, for dialogs not placed inside a DialogTrigger.

props.name: role
props.description: alertdialog also hides the close button and ignores backdrop clicks. Prefer AlertDialog.

props.name: children
props.description: A pressable trigger (usually a Button) followed by the Dialog, Sheet, AlertDialog or Popover it opens.

props.name: isOpen / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: Control the open state from outside.

keyboard.action: On the trigger: opens the dialog and moves focus into it.
Moves between focusable elements; focus is trapped inside the dialog.
Closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger.

notes: role="dialog" named by the title (h2) and described by the description.
Everything outside the dialog is hidden from assistive technology and page scrolling is locked while it is open.
The close button is labelled "Close" and comes last in the tab order, after the footer actions.

Overlays render in a portal on <body>, outside any ThemeScope. When it opens, the overlay copies data-strata-theme, data-strata-scheme and data-strata-density from the nearest [data-strata-theme] ancestor of its trigger (or of where the component is rendered, when controlled), plus dir and lang, onto its own root — so it uses the same tenant tokens and direction as the page region it came from, and nested overlays inherit from their parent overlay.
Right-to-left: set dir on the scope for layout, and wrap the app in React Aria's I18nProvider with an RTL locale so keyboard arrows and start/end placement flip too.

do: Keep dialogs to one task with one primary action in the footer.
Use the render function's close() for Cancel buttons.
Use a Sheet for long forms or filters that benefit from the full viewport height.
dont: Don't open a dialog from another dialog; replace the content or use a step flow.
Don't use a Dialog to confirm destructive actions — use AlertDialog.
Don't put essential information only in the description; it is supporting text.
